SELECT u.id, bu.nickname as nickname, u.nickname as username, bu.business_id, u.mobile FROM system_business_user bu INNER JOIN system_users u on u.id = bu.user_id AND u.deleted = b'0' LEFT JOIN system_org_user ou ON u.id = ou.user_id AND ou.deleted = b'0' WHERE ou.id IS NULL
AND u.deleted = b'0'
AND (u.username like concat('%', #{pageReqVO.nickname}, '%') or bu.nickname like concat('%', #{pageReqVO.nickname}, '%') or u.mobile like concat('%', #{pageReqVO.nickname}, '%'))
order by u.create_time desc
SELECT su.id, bu.nickname as nickname, su.nickname as username, su.mobile FROM system_business_user bu LEFT JOIN system_users su ON bu.user_id = su.id ${ew.customSqlSegment}

SELECT su.id, su.nickname as nickname, su.mobile FROM system_users su LEFT JOIN system_user_dept ud ON ud.user_id = su.id WHERE ud.dept_id = #{deptId} AND ud.deleted = b'0' AND su.deleted = b'0'
AND (su.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{nameOrMobile}, '%') OR su.mobile LIKE CONCAT('%', #{nameOrMobile}, '%'))
